arxiv-2204-04902.title: NeuS: Neutral Multi-News Summarization for Mitigating Framing Bias
arxiv-2204-04902.creator: Nayeon LeeYejin BangTiezheng Yu, Andrea MadottoPascale FungHong Kong University of Science and Technology nyleeaa@connect.ust.hk, pascale@ece.ust.hk
arxiv-2204-04902.description: Abstract Media news framing bias can increase political polarization and undermine civil society. The need for automatic mitigation methods is therefore growing. We propose a new task, a neutral summary generation from multiple news articles of the varying political leanings to facilitate balanced and unbiased news reading.

arxiv-2207-00747.title: Rationale-Augmented Ensembles in Language Models
arxiv-2207-00747.creator: Xuezhi Wang, Jason Wei, Dale Schuurmans, Quoc Le, Ed Chi, Denny Zhou
arxiv-2207-00747.description: Abstract Recent research has shown that rationales , or step-by-step chains of thought, can be used to improve performance in multi-step reasoning tasks. We reconsider rationale-augmented prompting for few-shot in-context learning, where (input → \rightarrow output) prompts are expanded to (input, rationale → \rightarrow output) prompts.

arxiv-2310-16262.title: rTisane: Externalizing conceptual models for data analysis increases engagement with domain knowledge and improves statistical model quality CCS: Human-centered computing User interface toolkits
arxiv-2310-16262.creator: Eunice Jun, Edward Misback, Jeffrey Heer, René Just
arxiv-2310-16262.description: Abstract . Statistical models should accurately reflect analysts’ domain knowledge about variables and their relationships. While recent tools let analysts express these assumptions and use them to produce a resulting statistical model, it remains unclear what analysts want to express and how externalization impacts statistical model quality. This paper addresses these gaps.

arxiv-2504-18089.title: Chalcogen Vacancies Rule Charge Recombination in Pnictogen Chalcohalide Solar-Cell Absorbers
arxiv-2504-18089.creator: Cibrán López, Seán R. Kavanagh, Pol Benítez, Edgardo Saucedo, Aron Walsh, David O. Scanlon, Claudio Cazorla
arxiv-2504-18089.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Cibrán López, Seán R. Kavanagh, Pol Benítez, Edgardo Saucedo, Aron Walsh, David O. Scanlon, Claudio Cazorla. Pnictogen chalcohalides (MChX, M = Bi, Sb; Ch = S, Se; X = I, Br) represent an emerging class of nontoxic photovoltaic absorbers, valued for their favorable synthesis conditions and excellent optoelectronic properties. Despite their proposed defect tolerance, stemming from the antibonding nature of their valence and conduction bands, their experimentally reported power conversion efficiencies remain below 10%, far from the ideal Shockley-Queisser limit of 30%.

arxiv-2506-17976.title: Threshold Displacement Energies of Oxygen in YBa 2 Cu 3 O 7 : A Multi-Physics Analysis
arxiv-2506-17976.creator: Ashley Dickson, Samuel T. Murphy, Mark R. Gilbert and Duc Nguyen-Manh
arxiv-2506-17976.description: Abstract Neutron bombardment of high temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets may compromise the integrity of the magnetic confinement in future fusion reactors. The amount of damage produced by a single neutron can be predicted from the threshold displacement energies (TDE) of the constituent ions in the HTS materials, such as the Rare Earth Cuperates.

arxiv-2507-03437.title: M ​ 1 M1 Radiative Transition of Light Mesons in the Light-Front Quark Model
arxiv-2507-03437.creator: Muhammad Ridwan \orcid 0000-0002-2949-5866 1†, Ahmad Jafar Arifi \orcid 0000-0002-9530-8993 2‡ and Terry Mart \orcid 0000-0003-4628-2245 1§
arxiv-2507-03437.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Muhammad Ridwan \orcid 0000-0002-2949-5866 1†, Ahmad Jafar Arifi \orcid 0000-0002-9530-8993 2‡ and Terry Mart \orcid 0000-0003-4628-2245 1§. We investigate the M ​ 1 M1 radiative transitions between light vector 𝒱 \mathcal{V} and pseudoscalar 𝒫 \mathcal{P} mesons in the 1S and 2S states in the light-front quark model. To this end, we use the light-front wave functions (LFWFs) obtained from the QCD-motivated effective Hamiltonian that includes smeared spin-spin interactions, where a few harmonic oscillator basis functions were employed as trial wave functions.

pmc-10611302.title: Nutritional Strategies to Promote Bovine Oocyte Quality for In Vitro Embryo Production: Do They Really Work?
pmc-10611302.creator: Miguel A. Velazquez
pmc-10611302.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Simple SummaryThe nutritional status of oocyte donors plays a significant role in the efficiency of in vitro embryo production (IVEP) in cattle. The available evidence suggests that oocyte donors with a moderate body condition score (i.e., 3 in a 1–5 scale) subjected to ovum pick have an increased chance of providing a metabolic microenvironment in ovarian follicles that will promote embryo formation in vitro.

pmc-13239361.description: Chronic Respiratory Diseases (CRDs) are a major global health burden, causing significant mortality and morbidity.
